title: Health Tidbits Ep 9: Is There a Criminal Brain? — Dr Daniel Amen on the Brain's Brake
description: Mimi and Alex distill Raj Shamani's conversation with psychiatrist Dr Daniel Amen: the prefrontal cortex as the brain's brake, why there is no single criminal brain, a reversible cyst case, brain reserve and Japanese walking, and why his SPECT scan claims need caution.

title: Health Tidbits Ep 8: Why You Are Always Bloated — Dr Shubham Vatsya on Gut Health
description: Mimi and Alex distill Dr Pal's conversation with gastroenterologist Dr Shubham Vatsya: incomplete evacuation as a hidden cause of bloating, red flags to check before labelling IBS, why adding fibre too fast backfires, his fibre, movement and water prescription with a footstool and no straining, careful psyllium use, and why colon cleanses and liver detoxes are a scam, plus cautions on uncited figures and stricter dashboard targets.

title: Health Tidbits Ep 7: Can Aging Be Reversed? — David Sinclair on Resetting Cell Age
description: Mimi and Alex distill David Sinclair's Diary Of A CEO conversation: aging as lost epigenetic information, three genes resetting cell age by about seventy five percent in animal tests, old mice living twice as long, a first human blindness trial, and fasting, exercise and hormesis today, plus cautions that no human reversal result exists yet and supplements are unproven.

title: Health Tidbits Ep 6: The Tiger That Isn't There — Anxiety, Drive and Your Brain
description: Mimi and Alex distill Raj Shamani's conversation with neuroscientist Vidita Vaidya: why no two brains are alike, why a couch potato and a billionaire share the same brain hardware, anxiety as a tiger response with no tiger, cortisol's dose curve from sharpening to shrinking the hippocampus, and hard learning as the best defence for your brain, plus a caution on brain-training apps.

title: Health Tidbits Ep 5: Vegetables First — Food, Protein and Diabetes
description: Mimi and Alex distill Dr Pal's conversation with lifestyle medicine physician Dr Nithya Subramaniam: vegetables at every meal, the NOVA food groups, thirty plants a week, saturated fat under ten percent with ghee capped at one teaspoon a day, eating only when hungry with an early light dinner, and why South Asians need prevention a decade earlier, plus cautions on the small Ornish study and the unproven milk claim.

title: Health Tidbits Ep 4: Feed Your Gut, Feed Your Brain
description: Mimi and Alex distill Professor Tim Spector's Diary Of A CEO microbiome episode: the gut-brain vagus nerve running mostly gut to brain, thirty plants a week, three fermented foods a day, pivoting protein toward fibre, quality over calories, and a twelve to fourteen hour overnight gut rest, plus a caution on his unproven Parkinson's theory and Zoe-linked studies.

Mimi and Alex distill Raj Shamani's conversation with Dr Vishakha: fasting safely without daily extremes, why fresh fruit juice and jalebi rank worst, deep sleep over sleep hours with a cool room and a two p.m. caffeine cutoff, blood-test-led supplements with omega three only, and five minutes of long-exhale breathing for stress.
title: Health Tidbits Ep 3: Fasting, Fruit Juice and Deep Sleep

description: Mimi and Alex distill Dr Pal's conversation with cardiac surgeon Dr Varun Bansal: why family history matters, how a fit 38-year-old ended up with triple-vessel disease, why the amount of cooking oil matters more than the type, and how an 87-year-old improved with post-meal walks.
title: Health Tidbits Ep 2: Why Healthy People Get Heart Attacks

description: Mimi and Alex distill Matthew Walker's Diary Of A CEO sleep episode from Naveen's doctor health podcast library: caffeine's three hidden costs, why sleep debt can't be banked, NASA nap rules, sleep and weight loss, and the 2 a.m. playbook.
title: Health Tidbits Ep 1: Sleep Like It Matters — Matthew Walker's Best Ideas
